notes: Sources: Cryogenic Ltd 10-18 T CFMS specification PDF (research/v5/cache/0a7d9545d8850630.txt), CFMS brochure v5.2 (research/v5/cache/8126d89197e64581.txt), product page (research/v5/cache/64cfe4e2f810e86e.txt), and drawings PDF cfm_drawings_0.pdf (snapshot research/v5/cache/a42b1692a66d21e4, image-only, three sheets: 'Complete Measurement System with VSM', 'Overall assembly Sumitomo rp-082b', 'Airlock and Wiper Seal' with NW40 gate valve; no dimension figures). The outer height/width/depth fields hold the COMPRESSOR dimensions, the only published outer dimensions; the cryostat body dimensions are not published anywhere found (web search, TU Dresden facility page, Cryogenic site) and are listed in not_found, so the renderer must not treat 632 x 450 x 500 mm as the cryostat. Cryocooler type is inconsistent across sources: brochure says 'Pulse Tube Cryocooler' and the drawing names Sumitomo RP-082B (pulse tube), while the 10-18 T spec sheet lists Sumitomo SRDK408 (GM, 1.0 W at 4.2 K, 34 W at 40 K) for 7 T and 9 T models; cold-head rate treated as unpublished. VTI sample space: spec says 25 mm for the IVTI-25 configuration; the brochure's generic CFMS table says 30 mm. Optical access, He-3 insert, DR insert, heat capacity (turbo-pumped relaxation probe) and heated probes are NOT fitted in this configuration.
